title: About This Project
text:
This project is a reproducible fantasy football analytics pipeline built with:

Polars for fast columnar data wrangling
YAML-driven fantasy scoring configuration
Automated weekly + season consolidation (intersection/union schema modes)
Optional headshot retrieval via the Sleeper API


Data Flow

Raw CSVs (Kaggle / scraped) placed in data/.
modules/data_cleaner.py cleans, normalizes, infers numeric types, and filters by current roster.
Consolidation creates unified Parquet(s) and applies scoring.
Curated extracts (planned) will live in data/curated/ for lightweight site renders.



Fantasy Scoring
Rules defined in config/scoring_config.yaml map stat tokens (e.g. PTD, RY10) to point multipliers.


Headshots
modules/player_images.py pulls player headshots (Sleeper) into data/headshots/. A mapping Parquet/CSV is written for joining.


Technology Choices



Aspect
Choice
Rationale




DataFrames
Polars
Performance & lazy API


Storage
Parquet (option DuckDB later)
Columnar & compact


Visualization
plotnine (planned in posts)
Grammar of graphics


Site
Quarto
Reproducible docs & code execution





Roadmap

Add positional weekly leader dashboards
Publish small sample dataset for public repo
Add DuckDB file for ad hoc SQL
Integrate great_tables formatting for nicer tables



License
Add an explicit license (MIT/Apache-2.0) at project root if you plan public reuse.


Contact
Open issues or discussions in the GitHub repository.
